Both devices feature a dark, solid rectangular casing with a U-shaped/octagonal measurement opening. Inside the opening, green laser beams form a visible 'X' pattern intersecting over a cable sample. Both models are equipped with an external WIFI antenna on the side. ### 1. Outline of LASER - H Series: Products use optical scanning measurement method, non-contact measurement method to measure the objects of diameter, width and thickness, ovality. Product adopts dual axis measurement, measuring cycle material is high accuracy, easy to use. Product is suitable for wire, cable, pipes or rods on-line measurement and monitoring. Products are suitable for quality inspection and material classification. Measuring flat material can display the width and thickness simultaneously, suitable for flat cable, flat metal wire measurement etc. Instrument has external access interface can be accessed DPM series displayer and controller, PLC or computer. --- ### 2. Principle of Measurement a) High-intensity green LED emits high-power green light.
b) The collimator lens makes the light parallel and collimated for emission.
c) The emitted light strikes the object, causing a shadow.
d) The telecentric optical system projects the shadow onto the CCD image sensor.
e) The accurate shadow image of the object is formed on the high-speed linear CCD.
f) The digital edge detection processor processes and calculates the measurements. > **Image Description:** A technical optical diagram illustrating the measurement principle. On the right, a "Photoelectric emitter unit" contains a "High-intensity green LED" (1) that shoots light through a "Collimating lens" (2), creating a wide, parallel green beam. In the center, a dark round "Object" (3) blocks part of the beam, creating a shadow. On the left, the light enters the "Photoelectric receiver unit" through a "Telecentric optical system" (4) which focuses the light and shadow onto a "CCD image sensor" (5). The resulting signal is then sent to an "ADC" (6) for digital processing. --- ### 3. Features of LASER-2020-H: - **High collimation light source** - Advanced custom light source and newly designed optical system ensure the accuracy and stability of sampling. - **DSP digital signal processing** - 10KHz Sampling Frequency, High-Speed Data Processing, Real-Time Data Stability And Reliability. - **Edge detection optimization** - Specially optimized edge algorithm for precise detection of the workpiece's edge. - **Online communication** - RS-485, Modbus, TCP/IP, WIFI. - **Dual-axis and multi-axis sampling** - More comprehensive sampling for more accurate results. Supports round wire roundness detection and flat wire width and thickness measurement. - **Long-term stable operation** - Maintains excellent performance and accuracy even after long-term use. High environmental resistance design. --- ### 4. Product Specification LASER - 2020H:
